summary.text:
Strategy for Public Health Preparedness and Response to Artificial Intelligence Threats
This bill requires the Department of Health and Human Services to develop a strategy for public health preparedness and response and biodefense that addresses the risks to national health security posed by the misuse of artificial intelligence, such as biological weapons and viruses and bacteria that are resistant to treatment.

title: Strategy for Public Health Preparedness and Response to Artificial Intelligence Threats
